prompt:
Locked-off camera. The man in rimless glasses, short beard, navy quilted gilet over a grey jumper sits centre frame facing the camera, right hand raised mid-explanation; the blurred tweed shoulder and grey head of a listener fill the right foreground. He says calmly and matter-of-factly, at a brisk natural pace, "Back home we vote on each thing. We had a vote on cow horns." with small, tidy hand movements, a tiny shrug of the shoulders on "cow horns", then stops and looks at the listener, waiting. Only his mouth moves for words; the listener in the foreground stays still. Same room, same warm wall-lamp light, only the people already in the frame, the picture clean. Small, real pub performance; photographic.
Thanks.
